_interpretation.quality_meaning: Bond lengths are physically sound (0.0% outside 0.85-1.80 A). Geometry is trustworthy.
_interpretation.terminal_meaning: All 16 expected terminal groups are present - the dendrimer is complete to this generation.
_interpretation.Rg_meaning: Root-mean-square spread of the heavy atoms about the centre is 13.922 A (diameter ~35.9 A as an equivalent sphere). Rg is the quantity measured by SAXS/SANS, so this is the most directly comparable size to experiment.
_interpretation.asphericity_meaning: delta = 0.5123 -> markedly elongated, far from spherical. Dendrimers become more spherical as generation rises; a high value at low generation is normal.
_interpretation.inertia_meaning: Ray's asymmetry kappa = -0.929 -> near-prolate symmetric top - cigar-shaped. (-1 = cigar, 0 = irregular, +1 = disc.) The axis of SMALLEST moment is the molecular long axis, because mass close to an axis resists rotation about it least.
_interpretation.principal_axis_meaning: Mass extends 2.22x further from axis 3 than from axis 1 - axis 1 is the long axis of the molecule. Axes are eigenvectors of the inertia tensor: computed, not chosen. [!] If two moments are within ~15% the corresponding axes are nearly degenerate and their directions are numerically unstable.
_interpretation.Rh_meaning: Kirkwood-Riseman hydrodynamic radius 11.198 A - the radius of the equivalent sphere that would diffuse at the same rate. This is the quantity measured by DLS.
_interpretation.Rh_method_meaning: The hard-sphere estimate gives 17.973 A, 61% different. The hard-sphere formula sqrt(5/3)*Rg assumes a uniform solid sphere and is unreliable for open or branched structures; prefer the Kirkwood value. D, s and [eta] all inherit this error, and [eta] scales as Rh^3 so it inherits ~3x.
_interpretation.Rg_Rh_meaning: Rg/Rh = 1.243 -> open, coil-like architecture (random coil ~1.5). [lit] Reference values: solid sphere 0.775, hollow shell ~1.0, random coil ~1.5. This ratio is a size-independent architecture diagnostic and is obtainable experimentally by combining SAXS with DLS.
_interpretation.void_meaning: Void fraction 83.95% [conv: bands 60/30/15%] -> very open interior - large capacity for guest molecules. This is the closest structural proxy to drug-loading capacity. [!] It is a static geometric measure: it does not distinguish space a guest molecule could actually occupy from voids too small or fragmented to use.
_interpretation.density_meaning: Molecular density 0.2223 g/cm3 -> low - open, solvent-permeable interior (typical of PAMAM/PLL backbones).
_interpretation.surface_crowding_meaning: 216.45 A2 of surface per terminal group -> ample room per terminal group; growth is not yet sterically limited.
_interpretation.backfolding_meaning: Mean terminal radius is 0.975 of the reference radius [conv: bands 0.95/0.85] -> terminals sit close to the outer surface - shell-like arrangement. 12.5% of terminals lie in the inner half of the available volume. They span 3.435-22.147 A from the centre (sd 4.348 A); a wide spread is itself the signature of back-folding, since a true shell would be narrow. [lit] Simulation consensus (Lescanec & Muthukumar 1990; Boris & Rubinstein 1996; Murat & Grest 1996) favours a DENSE-CORE structure with terminals distributed through the interior, not the original dense-shell picture of de Gennes & Hervet. Experiment is still split: Topp/Amis SANS placed PAMAM terminals near the periphery, while Ballauff's SANS found them dispersed with a maximum near half-radius.
_interpretation.charge_meaning: Net charge -0.0001 e - the structure is electrically neutral as built. Real dendrimers are protonated in solution: PAMAM surface amines carry + charge at physiological pH, interior tertiary amines protonate only below ~pH 6.5. Build explicitly protonated variants to model that.
_interpretation.dipole_meaning: Dipole moment 20.557 D. Meaningful (origin-independent) only because the net charge is ~0. Large values indicate asymmetric charge distribution across the molecule.
_interpretation.surface_charge_meaning: Surface charge density -0.00412 e/A2. [!] This is NOT a zeta potential and must not be reported as one. Zeta is an electrokinetic property of a solvated, ionised particle and cannot be obtained from a gas-phase structure. Surface charge density is the honest structural analogue, and there is evidence it predicts cytotoxicity better than zeta.
_interpretation.overall_caveat: Every value here describes ONE conformation of a flexible molecule. For publication, characterise an ensemble (independent builds or MD frames) and report mean +/- sd.
